candidates.text: Emissions notified to GaugeManager must eventually be allocated to gauges and reach their intended recipients, including when notification occurs while totalWeight is zero.
evidence_ids: This vulnerability causes permanent loss of scheduled emissions intended for distribution to users. When totalWeight is zero during emission notification, the transferred tokens remain in GaugeManager indefinitely with no recovery mechanism. This breaks the emission distribution policy and creates unclaimable funds, undermining the protocol's token economics and causing direct financial losses to stakeholders expecting those emissions.

Consider implementing a pending emission mechanism to handle notifications when totalWeight is zero. One approach could be to track unallocated emissions in a separate variable when totalWeight is zero, then incorporate these pending amounts into the index calculation once totalWeight becomes positive. This would ensure that all notified emissions eventually reach their intended recipients regardless of timing.

candidates.text: Notified emission tokens must not remain untracked and permanently stranded in GaugeManager with no recovery mechanism.
evidence_ids: The `GaugeManager` contract contains a critical flaw where emissions notified when `totalWeight` is zero are transferred into the contract but never allocated to gauges. This occurs because the `notifyRewardAmount` function transfers tokens but sets the ratio to zero when totalWeight is zero, preventing any index updates that would enable future distribution of these emissions.

This vulnerability causes permanent loss of scheduled emissions intended for distribution to users. When totalWeight is zero during emission notification, the transferred tokens remain in GaugeManager indefinitely with no recovery mechanism. This breaks the emission distribution policy and creates unclaimable funds, undermining the protocol's token economics and causing direct financial losses to stakeholders expecting those emissions.

Alternatively, the notification function could be modified to either reject emissions when totalWeight is zero or defer the transfer until voting weight is established, preventing the accumulation of stranded tokens while maintaining emission schedule integrity.
